name: Mental Health Counselor and Therapist
description: ⚠⚠ 18 percent growth from 2025 to 2035 and about 50,500 openings a year — against 6 percent for social workers and 6 percent for health education specialists. ⚠⚠⚠ And the numbers behind it are brutal: Florida awards 6,228 psychology bachelor's a year against roughly 372 counselling master's seats, the licensure master's is 60 semester hours rather than the usual 30 to 36, two more supervised years follow it, and the median is $59,350.
credentialNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE LMHC MASTER'S IS NEARLY TWICE THE SIZE OF A NORMAL ONE, AND THE STATUTE SPELLS IT OUT. Section 491.005(4), F.S. requires a minimum of an earned master's degree from a mental health counseling programme accredited by CACREP consisting of at least 60 SEMESTER HOURS. Within it, 33 semester hours of graduate coursework must include at least 3 semester hours in EACH of eleven content areas: counseling theories and practice; human growth and development; diagnosis and treatment of psychopathology; human sexuality; group theories and practice; individual evaluation and assessment; career and lifestyle assessment; research and program evaluation; social and cultural foundations; substance abuse; and legal, ethical and professional standards. ⚠⚠ Then at least 700 hours of university-sponsored supervised clinical practicum, internship or field experience, including at least 280 hours of DIRECT CLIENT SERVICES. ⚠ And then at least 2 years of clinical experience at the post-master's level, supervised by a licensed mental health counselor. ⚠⚠⚠ Add it up before committing: a 60-hour master's, 700 supervised hours inside it, and two more years after it. Most master's degrees are 30 to 36 hours, so this is roughly a double-length degree followed by an apprenticeship. ⚠ Marriage and family therapy and clinical social work are licensed under the SAME chapter with comparable structures; clinical psychology requires a doctorate. ⚠ Verify CACREP accreditation with CACREP.
bodyHtml:
The family, and the ladder inside it

RoleSOC2025 medianEmployedOpenings/yrEntry
Mental health / substance abuse counselor21-1018⚠ $59,350✅ 533,400✅ 50,500master's, 60 hours
Marriage and family therapist21-1013$66,94077,8007,700master's (87%)
Clinical / counseling psychologist19-3033✅ $100,58076,300⚠ 4,800⚠⚠ doctorate — 48% report post-doctoral training

⚠⚠⚠ $41,230 separates the counselor from the psychologist, and the difference is a doctorate plus, for about half the field, post-doctoral training. But the counselor role has ten times the annual openings. That is the trade, and it is unusually clean.

✅ The growth is genuine and large. BLS projects counselors to grow 18 percent from 2025 to 2035 — set that against 6 percent for social workers and 6 percent for health education specialists on the same projection round. Demand is not the problem in this field.

⚠⚠⚠ Seventeen psychology graduates for every counselling master's seat

Florida public institutionsCredentials a year
Psychology bachelor's10 universities (plus 27 state colleges teaching the prefix)⚠⚠ 6,228
Counselor education master's8285
Mental health counseling master's⚠ 257
Marriage and family therapy master's430
All counselling master's8⚠⚠⚠ ~372

⚠⚠ Do not read that as a queue. Private institutions add seats, and most psychology graduates are not trying to become counsellors. Read it as the reason to plan the graduate step in your FIRST year rather than your last — because the bachelor's on its own does not qualify you to practise anything, and the bottleneck is real.

✅ And the psychology bachelor's is a good degree. This site's own evidence: LSAC recorded 3,850 psychology applicants to law school, and Census microdata puts psychology THIRD among the undergraduate fields held by medical and health services managers, at 47,154 people. It goes places. It just does not go here by itself.

⚠⚠⚠ The degree is in the college of EDUCATION, not psychology

285 of Florida's roughly 372 counselling master's seats are coded COUNSELOR EDUCATION — an education code — against 57 under mental health counseling and 30 under marriage and family therapy.

The course prefixes say the same thing:

PrefixState collegesUniversities
PSY psychology✅ 2711
DEP developmental2710
CLP clinical2410
⚠⚠ MHS mental health services⚠⚠⚠ 19

⚠⚠⚠ Psychology is everywhere and the counselling curriculum is almost nowhere. MHS is a graduate prefix carried by nine universities and a single state college, and Florida's most widely carried counselling course is MHS6450 Addictions Counseling at eight institutions.

⚠ The practical instruction: when you search for a graduate counselling programme, search the college of education. A psychology major who looks only at psychology departments will conclude Florida barely teaches this, and will be wrong by a factor of five.

⚠⚠ What 60 semester hours actually means

A normal master's is 30 to 36 credit hours. Florida's statute sets the LMHC degree at 60, with eleven named content areas at three hours each, 700 supervised hours inside the degree and 280 of those in direct client services.

⚠⚠⚠ Then two more years of post-master's supervised practice before you are licensed. Counting from a bachelor's: roughly two to three years of coursework and four to five years before independent practice. At a $59,350 median.

⚠ This is not an argument against the work. The demand is the strongest on this page and the work matters. It is an argument for knowing the length and the number before you start, because the field's own literature tends to lead with the growth rate and stop there.

Necessary skills

  • Sitting with distress without fixing it. The hardest part, and the one people discover in practicum rather than in class.
  • Diagnostic reasoning against the DSM, which the statute names as its own content area.
  • Risk assessment — suicidality, harm, abuse reporting — where the decision is yours and immediate.
  • Documentation and ethics at the standard a licensing board will read back to you.
  • Case conceptualisation: turning a session into a plan, and a plan into measurable change.
  • Managing your own caseload and your own reactions. Burnout is the field's structural problem and the 50,500 annual openings partly reflect it.

Advice

⚠⚠⚠ Decide in your first year, not your last. Roughly 372 counselling master's seats a year in Florida against 6,228 psychology bachelor's means the graduate application is the whole game, and it rewards research experience, relevant work and faculty who know you.

⚠⚠ Look at the college of education when you search. Most of the seats are there, under counselor education.

⚠⚠ Compare the LMHC against the LCSW deliberately. Both are licensed under Florida chapter 491 with two post-master's years. But social work has 1,164 master's seats a year against counselling's 372, a wider set of exits (healthcare social work $67,880, macro practice $71,900 against the counselor's $59,350), and an advanced-standing route worth 22 credit hours if you take the CSWE-accredited bachelor's.

⚠ If the doctorate interests you, know what it costs. Clinical psychology pays $100,580 and 48% of the occupation reports post-doctoral training on top of the doctorate, on 4,800 openings a year.

And get direct client hours early, in any setting. Crisis lines, residential programmes, case aide work and substance use programmes all count as experience for admission, and they also tell you whether you can do this before you spend sixty credit hours finding out.

programs.note: The licensed route — 8 Florida public institutions, all universities, 285 master's a year under the counselor education code. ⚠⚠ Read its degrees note: the LMHC master's is 60 semester hours against a normal 30 to 36, with 700 supervised hours inside it.

⚠⚠⚠ The feeder, and the ratio is the single most useful number on this page: 6,228 bachelor's a year against roughly 372 counselling master's seats. ⚠ It is a strong general degree that goes many places — law, health administration, public health — and it qualifies you to practise nothing by itself.

⚠⚠ The alternative licence under the SAME Florida chapter, and on the numbers the better-resourced one: 1,164 MSW seats a year against counselling's 372, wider exits, and healthcare social work at $67,880 and macro practice at $71,900 against the counselor's $59,350. ⚠ Its advanced-standing route is worth 22 credit hours if you take the CSWE-accredited bachelor's.

⚠ Named because behavioural health at population scale — prevention, substance use programming, community mental health planning — is where counselling and public health meet, and county health departments employ both.

⚠ Not a route to the licence, but a large employer of behavioural disorder and substance abuse counselors: drug courts, corrections, diversion and re-entry. ⚠⚠ Named because the employment overlap is real and the credential overlap is zero.

courses.reason: Introduction to Psychology — 33 institutions, one of the most widely carried courses in Florida. The entry point, and available at nearly every state college.
⚠ Abnormal Psychology — 22 institutions, and the second most widely carried psychology course at lower division. The closest an undergraduate gets to the diagnostic content the LMHC statute names.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ Florida also numbers psychopathology at upper division (CLP4134 Childhood Psychopathology, 6 carriers) and as a graduate course (MHS6070, 6 carriers). The undergraduate version is a survey, not preparation for practice.

courses.reason: Human Growth and Development — 29 institutions. Human growth and development is one of the eleven content areas s. 491.005 names, so this is directly on the licensure path.
Social Psychology — 10 institutions at lower division. Social and cultural foundations is another of the statute's eleven areas.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ Also numbered SOP3004 at upper division, carried by 8 institutions.

courses.reason: ⚠ Elementary Statistics — 39 institutions. Research and program evaluation is one of the eleven statutory content areas, and graduate admission assumes statistics.
Research Methods in Psychology — 7 institutions. ⚠ The course that most distinguishes a competitive graduate application, because it is what lets you do research with a faculty member.
Psychology of Health and Illness — 7 institutions. Health psychology, and a bridge toward the healthcare settings where counselling employment is growing fastest.
Childhood Psychopathology — 6 institutions. Directly relevant if children and adolescents are the intended population, which is a large share of the field.
Psychology of Learning — 6 institutions. Behavioural principles underneath most of the evidence-based treatments you will be trained in.

⚠⚠ Addictions Counseling — 8 institutions, the most widely carried counselling course in Florida. Substance abuse is one of the eleven content areas the statute requires, and substance use is half the occupation's own title.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ GRADUATE. MHS is carried by 9 Florida universities and one state college — it is not an undergraduate prefix, and that is the whole shape of this path.

courses.reason: Clinical Mental Health Counseling in the Community — 7 institutions. The core clinical course of the master's.
Psychopathology — 6 institutions. Diagnosis and treatment of psychopathology is a named statutory content area and this is where it is covered at the required depth.

Child Maltreatment and Child Welfare — 5 institutions. ⚠ Named across the prefix boundary deliberately: mandatory reporting and child protection are unavoidable in counselling practice, and this is where Florida teaches them properly.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ A social work prefix. Taking it does not count toward a social work degree, but the content is directly applicable.

courses.reason: English Composition I — 39 institutions. Clinical documentation is a licensed professional's legal record and a licensing board will read it.
Fundamentals of Speech Communication — 16 institutions. Graduate counselling admission is interview-heavy, and the job is a conversation conducted under discipline.

sources.note: ⚠⚠⚠ A master's from a CACREP-accredited mental health counseling programme of at least 60 SEMESTER HOURS, including 33 semester hours with a minimum of 3 hours in each of eleven named content areas; at least 700 hours of university-sponsored supervised practicum or internship including at least 280 hours of DIRECT CLIENT SERVICES; and at least 2 years of post-master's clinical experience supervised by a licensed mental health counselor. ⚠ Most master's degrees are 30 to 36 hours.

sources.note: ⚠⚠⚠ The access inversion, measured over the whole file: the PSY prefix is carried by 27 Florida STATE COLLEGES and 11 universities, DEP by 27 and 10, CLP by 24 and 10 — while MHS, the counselling prefix, is carried by 9 universities and exactly ONE state college. ⚠ MHS is also overwhelmingly graduate: 215 graduate course numbers against 128 undergraduate. The most widely carried counselling course in the state is MHS6450 Addictions Counseling, at eight institutions.
